body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> ASUS(CEO: Jerry Shen) unveiled the world's first notebook pc equipped with 512GB SSD at the company's official press conference during CES 2009 in Las Vegas.

Powered by Intel Atom Z520 processor with ASUS Super Hybrid Engine, it adopts a 12.2-inch slim chassis with fashion details. Boasting 8 hours of battery life, it measures 11.7 x 8.3 x 0.9~1-inch at 3 lbs weight.
